result.summary: The page layout is largely intact: header, search, chips, promo banner, carousels, and bottom navigation render cleanly with no overlapping or misaligned elements. The only defects are content-level: a meaningless discount badge and redundant delivery-fee information. Clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom were excluded as intended features.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' pizza card shows a discount badge reading '–0%', which is meaningless and looks like a rendering error.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount is zero, or show a real discount value.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows '€0 delivery' twice: once as a badge on the image and again in the metadata line below.
issues.suggestion: Remove the duplicate delivery-fee mention from either the image badge or the metadata line.
